title: ever RAYVEN|Shimmering All Over V-Neck Long Lantern Sleeve Sequin A-Line Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Step into the spotlight and steal the show in this mesmerizing Shimmering All Over V-Neck Long Lantern Sleeve Sequin A-Line Evening Dress. The dazzling sequins and elegant A-line silhouette make it an ideal choice for sophisticated gala events, red carpet premieres, or glamorous black-tie affairs.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style:Long sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
